metadata.title: Curriculum | Sanskriti Kindergarten
metadata.description: Explore Sanskriti Kindergarten's CIGMA curriculum, activity-based learning, skill development, developmental spheres, pedagogy, and activities.

hero.subtitle: Playful learning for confident early years.
hero.description: A child-centered curriculum that builds thinking, expression, movement, and creativity through joyful daily experiences.

image.alt: Children exploring classroom learning materials at Sanskriti Kindergarten

highlights.title: Child-Centered Learning
highlights.description: Experiences are shaped around how young children explore and absorb ideas.

highlights.title: Thinking and Understanding
highlights.description: Children learn to notice, connect, and make sense of the world.

highlights.title: Curiosity and Independence
highlights.description: Children ask questions, make choices, and participate with confidence.

highlights.title: Continuous Observation
highlights.description: Teachers observe progress and guide each child through the year.

cigma.title: CIGMA: Thoughtful Early Learning
cigma.description: CIGMA helps children think, understand, explore, and grow through meaningful engagement and continuous observation.

pillars.title: Child-Centered Learning
pillars.description: Learning follows each child's natural pace of exploration.

pillars.title: Thinking and Understanding
pillars.description: Children build understanding through noticing, connecting, and trying.

pillars.title: Curiosity and Independence
pillars.description: Children ask questions, make choices, and join activities with confidence.

pillars.title: Continuous Observation
pillars.description: Teachers observe progress and guide next steps with care.

activityLearning.title: Learning by doing, every day.
activityLearning.description: Children observe, listen, speak, act, and revisit ideas through playful hands-on experiences.

image.alt: Teacher guiding children through hands-on classroom activities

items.title: Observe, listen, speak, act
items.description: Children notice, respond, communicate, and take part actively.

items.title: Learning by doing
items.description: Practical experiences help children connect ideas with action.

items.title: Fun, engaging exploration
items.description: Play keeps children interested while building confidence and imagination.

items.title: Concept clarity through play
items.description: Hands-on repetition makes early concepts feel clear and natural.

skillDevelopment.title: Movement, coordination, and confidence
skillDevelopment.description: Fine and gross motor activities build coordination, balance, creativity, and everyday independence.
skillDevelopment.note: Motor practice is woven into classroom routines so children build control, balance, and confidence without pressure.

image.alt: Children building fine and gross motor skills through play

groups.label: Skill Development
groups.title: Fine Motor Skills
groups.description: Playful practice strengthens finger control, hand-eye coordination, and writing readiness.

groups.label: Skill Development
groups.title: Gross Motor Skills
groups.description: Movement activities improve balance, strength, coordination, and physical confidence.

developmentSpheres.title: Holistic growth across seven areas.
developmentSpheres.description: Our curriculum supports academic, emotional, social, physical, creative, and value-based growth.

image.alt: Children exploring creative, social, physical, and cognitive activities together

items.title: Cognitive Development
items.description: Building memory, reasoning, problem-solving, and early concept understanding.

items.title: Language Development
items.description: Strengthening listening, speaking, vocabulary, and confident expression.

items.title: Physical Development
items.description: Supporting balance, coordination, movement control, and overall fitness.

items.title: Social Development
items.description: Helping children share, cooperate, participate, and build healthy peer relationships.

items.title: Emotional Development
items.description: Creating space for self-awareness, comfort, empathy, and emotional confidence.

items.title: Creative Development
items.description: Encouraging imagination through art, storytelling, movement, and free expression.

items.title: Moral / Value Development
items.description: Nurturing kindness, responsibility, respect, and positive everyday habits.

pedagogy.title: Thoughtful teaching methods.
pedagogy.description: Structured guidance and joyful participation keep learning active, supportive, and natural.

image.alt: Teacher encouraging interactive discussion and experiential learning

items.title: Multiple Intelligence Approach
items.description: The classroom supports language, movement, music, creativity, logic, and social growth.

items.title: Experiential Learning
items.description: Children learn through experiences they can see, touch, try, and revisit.

items.title: Interactive Methods
items.description: Conversation, demonstration, and group participation keep learning active.

coCurricular.title: Shared experiences that build expression and participation.
coCurricular.summary: Children practice confidence, collaboration, and celebration through shared school experiences.

extraCurricular.title: Creative experiences that add movement, imagination, and life skills.
extraCurricular.summary: Creative movement, arts, nature, and role play add joyful variety to the learning week.

cta.title: Give your child a joyful start to learning.
cta.description: Discover a curriculum built around curiosity, confidence, creativity, and caring guidance.
